title: Effect Interpreter repository query protocol v1
$comment: Canonical JSON is pretty UTF-8 JSON with this schema's required field order, lexicographically sorted map keys, no duplicate object keys, no alternate whitespace, and exactly one trailing LF. Every nullable field is emitted explicitly; v1 has no omitted envelope fields or compatibility defaults. Unicode scalar values are preserved without normalization or host-locale rewriting. Identity paths use forward slashes, are repository-relative, and contain no empty, dot, or dot-dot segment. Stable hashes are BLAKE3 over 'effinterp/stable-id/v1\0', the named domain, '\0', and compact JSON with sorted object keys. Domains and inputs are: analysis-configuration/v1 over configuration; analysis-subject/v1 over the complete typed subject descriptor; analysis-occurrence/v1 over the occurrence descriptor; analysis-fact/v1 over operation, normalized resource identity, realm, modality, attributes, condition, provenance roots, and dispatch; analysis-boundary/v1 over class, reason, domains, detail, limit, provenance roots, and dispatch; repo-query-content/v1 over the complete envelope except content_hash. Snapshot IDs use effinterp/repo-snapshot/v1 over the key, kind, and prefixed digest of every dependency. None of these inputs contains absolute checkout location, host environment, insertion order, or renderer text.

subjects.$comment: Strictly ordered by unique entrypoint identity. Every complete or partial payload entrypoint reference names one of these subjects; stale payloads may describe a subject removed from the current working tree.

resource_expression.$comment: A normalized Effect Interpreter resource expression. Union alternatives are strictly ordered by compact canonical JSON and duplicate-free; join parts retain semantic order.

domains.$comment: Strict lexicographic order; duplicates are forbidden.

provenance_roots.$comment: Duplicates are forbidden; order retains the semantic provenance path.

payload_boundary_row.$comment: Every field restated here equals the identity-bearing top-level boundary selected by boundary_id.

effects.$comment: Strictly ordered by the canonical fact value; duplicate facts and duplicate fact ids are forbidden.

boundaries.$comment: Strictly ordered by reason, domains, detail, limit, and dispatch; duplicates are forbidden.

source_file.$comment: Names a source_module dependency in identity.dependencies.

provenance_roots.$comment: Duplicates are forbidden; order retains the semantic provenance path.

boundary_indeterminate_hit.$comment: boundary_reason, boundary_detail, limit, dispatch, and provenance_roots equal the top-level boundary selected by boundary_id; domain is one of that record's domains.

matches.$comment: Strictly ordered by the complete canonical row value; duplicates are forbidden.

indeterminate.$comment: Strictly ordered by the complete canonical row value; duplicates are forbidden.

build_digest.$comment: Content identity of the protocol, engine, and repository analyzer sources and their locked build inputs; it is not derived from the analyzer version string.

dependencies.$comment: Strictly ordered by key; keys are unique and their namespace must match kind.

subject.$comment: The complete preimage of subject_digest under effinterp/analysis-subject/v1.

entrypoints.$comment: Strict lexicographic order; empty exactly when all_entrypoints is true.

graphs.$comment: Strict enum order: effects, execution, occurrences, resource_state, causality, provenance.

reasons.$comment: Strictly ordered by compact canonical JSON; duplicates are forbidden.
Strictly ordered by compact canonical JSON; duplicates are forbidden.

edges.$comment: Strictly ordered by from, then kind enum order (derived_from, calls, applies_model, dispatches, supports), then to.
